A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Transparent and Coherent Procedural Mistake Detection. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E are readable and can be matched reliably despite pagination shifts.

before.justification: v3 reports original Ego4D-PMD model evaluations in Tables 1–2, human annotation studies in Appendix C, and supplementary experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v4 retains the original model evaluations, human annotation results, and supplementary experiments reported in v3.

M1.justification: The visual self-dialog procedure, coherence-based question ranking, in-context augmentation, and DPO fine-tuning remain unchanged. The added dataset-construction citation introduces no procedural revision.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Ego4D-PMD coverage and mistake categories. Appendix A's new statement about extension to more datasets refers to Li et al. (2025b), not additional datasets evaluated in this paper.

E2.justification: The evaluated InstructBLIP, LLaVA, Llama 3, and GPT-4o comparisons remain unchanged, including the rationale-free and diversity-ranking comparisons in Appendix E. The newly cited work is not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The 10,000/500/2,000 training/validation/testing samples, evaluation metrics, model configurations, hyperparameter searches, and human-study procedures are unchanged. Appendix settings are retained despite reflow.

E4.justification: Both retain the training-data ablation, runtime analysis, rationale-free evaluation, question-source analysis, length-penalty experiment, and diagnostic cases in Appendix E. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains the same correlation tests, p-values, and agreement reporting, while Table 6 retains runtime and iteration standard deviations. No repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains 67.8% accuracy for LLaVA with coherence ranking and ICL and 55.4% for GPT-4o.

T1.justification: The coherent-PMD formulation, NLI-based relevance and informativeness definitions, ranking expression, and Appendix E.10 length-penalty formula remain unchanged. No formal reasoning or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about transparency, coherence, accuracy, and efficiency tradeoffs.

C2.justification: Interpretations of question complexity, visual errors, and coherence–accuracy tradeoffs are unchanged. The limitations concerning latency, single frames, and absent ground-truth rationales are also retained.

D1.justification: Data-processing instructions, prompts, quantization, training hyperparameters, hardware, runtime details, and code/data access information are unchanged. The new related-work pointer supplies no additional implementation instructions.

R1.justification: v4 adds Li et al. (2025b), Mistake Attribution: Fine-grained Mistake Understanding in Egocentric Videos, in Section 2.3 and the bibliography. Appendix A identifies it as further developing the mismatch-generation approach and extending it to more datasets.

P1.justification: v4 adds one contextual sentence in Appendix A and shortens 'As listed there, to conserve compute' to 'To conserve compute' in Section 2.3. Citation-year disambiguation also changes, while the narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: References and appendices reflow, relocating existing displays: Figure 6 moves from PDF page 31 to 32, and Table 18 from page 33 to 34. Figure content, table structure, captions, and overall formatting are retained.

improvement.justification: The added citation and Appendix A sentence provide a small amount of context about follow-up research. They leave the paper's scientific evidence, explanations, reproducibility, and limitations unchanged; the limited wording edit and display relocation produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
